metadata.title: Refactored Playwright and added more tests
metadata.author: madrian13

description:
## Summary
Refactored Playwright test suite to implement comprehensive Page Object Model pattern with improved test organization and reusability.

## Changes
- ✨ Created dedicated page objects for all major pages (Agents, Gateways, MCP Registry, Servers, Tools, Resources, Prompts, Tokens, Team, Version, Metrics)
- 🏗️ Implemented reusable component pattern (Sidebar component)
- 📝 Added comprehensive test coverage for new pages
- 🔧 Improved base page with common utilities
- 📚 Added documentation and migration guides
- 🧪 Enhanced entity-level tests for better isolation

## Files Changed
- 38 files changed, 11,614 insertions(+), 709 deletions(-)
- New page objects in `pages/` directory
- New component pattern in `pages/components/`
- Enhanced entity tests in `entities/`


## Testing
All tests have been validated and follow the Page Object Model pattern for better maintainability.

Signed-off-by: Matei Adrian

commits.message:
feat(testing): refactor Playwright tests to Page Object Model pattern

- Implement comprehensive POM with dedicated page objects for all admin pages
  (Agents, Gateways, MCP Registry, Servers, Tools, Resources, Prompts, etc.)
- Extract reusable SidebarComponent for tab navigation
- Add LoginPage for authentication flow encapsulation
- Create admin_utils.py with generic CRUD helpers (find/delete/cleanup)
- Add extended server tests covering visibility, OAuth, associations
- Add gateway tests with auth type configuration coverage
- Add version page and MCP registry page tests
- Refactor conftest.py fixtures to return typed page objects
- Fix: remove debug page.pause() breakpoint
- Fix: remove password leak in debug print statements
- Fix: add missing VersionPage/MCPRegistryPage to __init__.py exports
- Fix: correct type annotations (Optional[int]) in base_page.py
- Fix: bare except clause in gateways_page.py
- Fix: login_page.navigate() return type annotation

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Adrian M

commits.message:
fix(testing): improve Playwright test quality and linter compliance

- Replace all print statements with proper logging (gateways_page.py,
  test_gateways.py) using logger.info/warning/debug
- Remove unused imports across 11 files (typing, Page, pytest, re,
  find_server, find_tool)
- Eliminate duplicate state in test_auth.py by importing constants
  from conftest instead of redefining them
- Fix meaningless assertion in test_create_agent_no_auth (now asserts
  no 5xx server error)
- Remove unreachable code after while-True loop in
  gateways_page.delete_gateway_by_url
- Replace brittle placeholder-based selector in tokens_page.py with
  form-scoped input[name="name"]
- Remove 11 useless __init__ delegations in page objects
- Consolidate uuid imports to module level in conftest.py (was imported
  inline in 9 fixtures)
- Fix pylint style issues (no-else-return in test_auth.py and
  mcp_registry_page.py)
- Add @pytest.mark.auth marker to TestAuthentication class
- Fix unused variable warnings (expected_headers, initial_count)
- Apply black + isort formatting across all 36 files

Linter results: ruff (0 errors), flake8 (0 errors), pylint (9.98/10)

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(testing): add Authorization header for Playwright API calls

The admin API rejects cookie-based auth for programmatic requests
(page.request), returning 401. Extract JWT from browser cookies and
pass it as a Bearer token header in find/delete utility functions.
Centralize delete calls through admin_utils helpers.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(testing): handle flaky gateway and token Playwright tests

Gateway creation tests now use expect_response with 120s timeout
and skip on server errors (external MCP service unavailable).
Token test marked as xfail for server-side RBAC naming collision bug.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(testing): fix servers extended tests reload navigation

After page.reload(), the admin UI defaults to gateways tab.
Add navigate_to_servers_tab() after reload so the servers panel
is visible for subsequent assertions.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(testing): fix add server button locator strict mode violation

The server form contains nested association containers (gateways,
tools, resources, prompts) that render "Sign In" submit buttons
when HTMX auth fails. Use get_by_role("button", name="Add Server")
to target only the actual submit button.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
